rules.raw:
.paper-sheet {
  position: relative;
  background-color: var(--color-paper);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 18% 22%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--foxing-base) 6%, transparent) 0,
      transparent 38%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 82% 78%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--foxing-base) 5%, transparent) 0,
      transparent 42%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 50%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper-soft) 60%, transparent) 0,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 1.8%, transparent) 0 2px,
      transparent 2px 6px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 30% 40%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 4%, transparent) 0 1px,
      transparent 1.4px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 70% 60%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 3.5%, transparent) 0 1px,
      transparent 1.4px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 15% 85%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 3%, transparent) 0 1px,
      transparent 1.4px
    );
  background-size:
    auto,
    auto,
    auto,
    auto,
    5px 5px,
    7px 7px,
    9px 9px;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 60px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foxing-base) 8%, transparent),
    inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 4%, transparent);
}
